title: Imagine If:
title_short: Tin Can · Courtney · The Space in Between
headline: Two strangers hold a string across a busy park path. One says the answer to division is not a fight. It is the space in between.
story: Kalindi asks Courtney through a tin can: are we related? Courtney says yes, we all come from the same ancestor, and we are built to connect. But we are also built to form groups, and that puts walls between people.

Then her answer: space. Her best answers never came from forcing. They came from the space in between. People, bikes and strollers keep passing between the two cans: the picture says the same thing. One person, about 38 seconds.
do: Text on frame 1: “ARE WE RELATED?” Already on screen at 0:00.
Set the scene by 0:06: the string pulled tight between the cans and the readable bench sign.
Let people walk through the string. That is the idea of the video.
Use the close shots (from 11:00 in 764_3904) for the last line.
Cut from the MXF. Match the look of the Tin Cans montage.
dont: Do not use 764_3904 4:55–6:15 or 9:55–10:05. Private family story. Never in any cut.
Do not use 8:05–8:15 (“shut the f up”).
No Taoism words on screen. Her idea is “space”, keep it simple.
Do not use her singing. That is its own video (Let It Resonate).
No name super. No second aspect ratio.

tech: Picture: 764 MXF files, 16:9. The Monday brief says 1920×1080, 23.98 fps. Our probe could only read the proxies (960×540, 23.976 fps, several mono audio tracks). Check the MXF in the NLE before you set the timeline.
1080×1920 at 23.976 fps. Same as the source. No conversion.

A 9:16 crop of 1080p is 608 px wide, so it is already upscaled 1.78×. Keep punch-ins at 110% or less. Sharpen lightly. Most of the talk is a wide shot: Courtney is small on the left, Kalindi on the right. Crop left for Courtney. From about 11:00 the camera is close on Courtney: use that for the last line.
Audio is in the camera. The MXF has several mono tracks. Solo each track and use the one with the clear voice. We did not measure the channels here.
−14 LUFS integrated, −1 dBTP peak. Any music 18–20 dB under the voice.
Royal-blue box #1E6FD6, white text, floating over the speaker. Max 2 lines. Keep the bottom 20% clear.
H.264 MP4, 1080×1920, about 16 Mbps. One file. 9:16 only. Deliver to Frame.io → Ready for Review.
checklist: Write “Search for Common Ground”: capital S, small “for”. Never SFCG, CGLA or a Preemptive Love logo on screen.
The hook text is already on screen at 0:00. It does not animate on. No logo, title card, name or fade at 0:00.
Captions match the audio word for word. Keep the speaker’s own grammar.
No camera-shutter sounds. Every jump cut is covered.
No animation in the middle (Kalindi: “it was inauthentic”).
No name and no place name on screen.
End card: Search for Common Ground lockup + sfcg.org. Nothing under it.
Cut from the MXF in RAW, never from the proxy. 9:16 only.
The string and the bench sign are on screen and readable by 0:11.
Nothing from 764_3904 4:55–6:15 or 9:55–10:05, sound or picture.
Only Courtney and Kalindi’s question. No singing in this video.

decisions.b: The end card reads sfcg.org. Search is still building the Imagine If landing page (Yana owns it). One end-card pass across the batch when the link exists.
